newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: FSA said it has qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Cedar Falls, Iowa, $3.5 million and $4.5 million corporate purpose bonds.
--Randolph CSD, N.Y., $2.77 million school district bonds.
--Florida Department of Transportation $44 milion of revenue bonds.
--Atwater ISD #2396, Minn., $7.7 million of scholl buildingbonds.
--GFW Public ISD #2365, Minn., $3.2 million GO school buildingbonds.
--Virginia ISD #706, Minn., $6 million of GO school buildingbonds.
--Montgomery County, Texas, $4.625 million certificates of obligation.
--Sachse, Texas, $1.14 million tax and revenue certificates.
